method: Every page of the preserved primary scan is compared with the transcription and a hash-pinned Sahitya Ras digital witness. The primary edition governs. A second visual review reconciles corrections, paragraph and verse boundaries, notes, numbering and endings before publication. Authentic spelling and wording are retained; editions are not substituted automatically.
